technical_and_design_decisions: Use Spring Integration as the core framework for building XD modules and pipelines.
Leverage Spring Cloud Stream for binding to multiple external systems in U1.
Implement HDFS HA support using Hadoop's NameNodeProxies API for U2.
Migrate Cassandra module to use Spring Data Cassandra for U3.
Use PMML libraries for analytics processing in U4.
Expose job composition details via REST endpoints using Spring MVC for U5 and U6.
Design UI components to visually distinguish job types for U7 and U8.
Use JSON-based REST APIs for all new endpoints.
Follow existing XD module structure and conventions during migration.
assumptions: Development will be done in Java 17+ as required by Spring Framework 6.0.
Existing XD infrastructure and build tools (Maven) are available.
Access to Hadoop cluster with HA configuration for testing U2.
Cassandra instance available for testing U3.
PMML model files available for testing U4.
UI development uses existing XD dashboard framework.
REST endpoints follow existing XD API conventions.
All modules will be tested with unit and integration tests.
Documentation updates are included in development effort.

activities.activity_name: Analyze requirements and design solution architecture
activities.activity_description: Review all user stories, understand existing XD codebase, and design architecture for multi-system binding, HDFS HA support, module migrations, and job composition features.
Develop Spring Cloud Stream bindings to allow connecting to multiple external systems for the same binding type.
Fix HDFS custom module to properly handle NameNode HA configurations using appropriate Hadoop APIs.

activities.activity_name: Migrate Cassandra module to s-c-s repo (U3)
activities.activity_description: Port Cassandra module from XD to Spring Cloud Stream repository and configure as sink module.

activities.activity_name: Port analytic-pmml module to s-c-s repo (U4)
activities.activity_description: Migrate PMML analytics module from XD to Spring Cloud Stream and configure as processor module.

activities.activity_name: Implement job composition flag REST endpoint (U5)
activities.activity_description: Create REST endpoint that returns job composition flag to differentiate parent-child relationships from standalone jobs.

activities.activity_name: Implement job composition graph REST endpoint (U6)
activities.activity_description: Create REST endpoint that returns job composition graph for building visual representations.

activities.activity_name: Implement UI differentiation for job types (U7)
activities.activity_description: Develop UI components to visually differentiate between job-composition workflows and single jobs.
Enable clicking through to job detail pages regardless of whether the entity is singular or part of a composed job.
Create comprehensive test coverage for all implemented features including module migrations and REST endpoints.
Document new features, configuration changes, and usage instructions for all implemented functionality.
